# Unit 2: Environmental Justice {#sec-EJ}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This unit focuses on the identification and quantification of the unequal distribution and access to natural resources within California and the United States.  It also takes a critical look at the Government generated environmental data visualization tools and underlying methods used to characterize Environmental Justice.
:::
